newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bill yields rise, 12-mo same.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bill yields rise, 12-mo same.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury rose to 51.30 percent from 45.96 percent at the last sale on November 15, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.
The results of Tuesday auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 12.051 million UAH 35,867 UAH Average yield 51.30 pct 45.96 pct
The central bank sold 135,928 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 21.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 57.56 percent from 55.23 percent at the last sale on November 15, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 13.038 million UAH 1.885 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.131 million UAH 1.146 million UAH
The central bank sold 130,383 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 21.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills rose to 58.26 percent from 58.20 percent at the last sale on November 14, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 2,743 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 21.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills remained unchanged at 60.94 percent from the last sale on November 5, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue
of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 220 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 21. --Kiev newsroom +380 44 229-2264
